metadata.description: Plugins used in the AI YouTube course.

plugins.name: borumi
plugins.description: The cut and the visuals: edit a Borumi project from Claude Code. Remove silences and retakes, cut ranges, add chapter cards and captions, and visualize a scene with a rendered animation behind or in front of your camera.

plugins.name: content-repurpose-system
plugins.description: Turn a finished video into everything you post: vertical reels with hooks to film, tweet-style and Pixel-Pal carousels, a blog article, X/LinkedIn/Threads posts, and a finished-products folder with a publish plan.
